glosses: het aanbrengen van voorwerpen door doorboring van de huid

translations.source_sense_description: het aanbrengen van voorwerpen door doorboring van de huid

examples.text: The diver pierced the surface of the water with scarcely a splash.
to pierce the enemy's line; a shot pierced the ship
I pierce her open back, or tender side
What appliance can pierce through the outer layers of a star and test the conditions within?

glosses: To create a hole in the skin for the purpose of inserting jewelry.

examples.text: Can you believe he pierced his tongue?
A dreadful scream pierced the silence.

glosses: To get to the heart or crux of (a matter).

examples.text: A stab of fear pierced my heart.
The flatness of the landscape facilitates views right across the Firth of Forth to Fife, before the railway begins to pierce the Edinburgh suburbs.
